profile.headline: Software Developer @ Talbots | Data Visualization, Database Development
profile.summary:
As an ETL Developer, I work on various business intelligence tools and database development projects that support e-commerce and marketing operations. I have experience in software development, including object-oriented design principles, data analysis and transformation, and job scheduling software.

I have a strong ability to solve analytical problems and collaborate with different teams and stakeholders. I also enjoy learning new skills and technologies that are relevant to the industry offering quick learning and adaptability.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Strong knowledge and experience in Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS and data visualization.
Collaborate with MicroStrategy report developers to develop data models to support reporting requirements.
Develop SQL server database objects like tables, stored procedures, functions, indexes, triggers, user defined functions and views.
Extract, transform and load(ETL) large data sets from source to SQL server using SSIS integration projects
Develop, maintain, optimize and deploy SSIS packages
Job scheduling using AutoSys Workload Automation, created and optimized JIL codes
Experience in SQL server Analysis services(SSAS) for developing multidimensional data models(MDX) and organize data into cubes, dimensions, and measures
Supports users with ad hoc data requests, frequently using excel pivot tables.
Develop deployment plans, scheduled changes utilizing ITSM, and facilitated stakeholder communication.
Identify and implement solutions to resolve production incidents, including applying known fixes, implementing temporary workarounds to minimize impact, restarting services, or making configuration changes.
Documented production issues for future reference and ongoing improvement initiatives.
Upgraded and tested SSAS and SSIS from 2005 to 2022 versions. More than 1500 SSIS packages migrated and tested from 2005 to 2022 
Experience in client requirement analysis, logical design, resource planning, coding, debugging, testing, deployment, support and maintenance.
positions.insights: Excel Pivot, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and +35 skills

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Develop web and database functionality to support PDIS(CMS) and provide ongoing support for diagnosticians in 33 universities and private labs across the US.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand the specific needs of the PDIS.
Designed an efficient database schema to store diagnostic data securely in MS SQL Server.
Plan for mobile responsiveness and compatibility using KendoUI for mobile development.
Implement backend logic using C# to handle user authentication, and interaction with the database.
Develop intuitive and responsive UI components using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.
Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing, to identify and rectify any bugs or issues.
Collaborate with diagnosticians for user acceptance testing to ensure the system meets their needs and expectations.
Provide continuous support to diagnosticians, addressing any technical issues or queries promptly.
Monitor system performance and security, implementing updates and patches as necessary to ensure smooth operation.
Offer training sessions and documentation to assist diagnosticians in utilizing the system effectively.
Conduct webinars to familiarize users with the system
Gather feedback from diagnosticians and stakeholders to identify areas for improvement.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, ASP.NET MVC and +16 skills

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Participated in application design and code development
Designed layout and navigation elements to enhance user experience.
Employed analytical skills and attention to detail to debug and fix issues efficiently.
Followed established standards and guidelines to ensure consistency, maintainability, and compatibility with industry norms.
